text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is today. Meisho Doto timidly steps up to her first self-initiated challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to become capable of supporting T.M. Opera O, she presses forward with the well-wishes of her best friend, Matikanefukukitaru.
